warning_combinations.reason: Body-emphasis framing and a low angle are stacked; confirm that this is intentional and subordinate to the concept core.

match_any_terms: robot concept proof or scene anchor

en.compact: Let one quiet imperfection, shared light, and a small material trace make the frame feel discovered rather than assembled.
en.default: Let the final frame keep one quiet imperfection, shared light across subject and setting, and a small material trace, so it feels discovered by a real photographer rather than assembled as a clean concept image.

dimensions.baseline_principle: Decide what the frame is about before adding surface style, so the image has a visible reason for its distance, angle, and timing.

guidance.en: make the frame's photographic intent legible before surface styling
guidance.ko: 표면적인 스타일보다 먼저 프레임의 촬영 의도가 읽히게 한다

dimensions.label: shot intent

guidance.en: let the close distance feel observed rather than displayed
guidance.ko: 가까운 거리가 과시가 아니라 관찰처럼 느껴지게 한다

refinements.principle: For close or intimate subjects, make the chosen distance feel observed rather than displayed.

guidance.en: let surface, weight, use, or arrangement explain why this frame exists
guidance.ko: 표면, 무게, 사용감, 배치가 이 프레임의 이유를 설명하게 한다

refinements.principle: For non-human subjects, make the frame's reason come from surface, weight, use, or arrangement rather than a label-like display.

guidance.en: let scale, distance, and spatial relation carry the frame's purpose
guidance.ko: 스케일, 거리, 공간 관계가 프레임의 목적을 이끌게 한다

refinements.principle: For environment-led frames, make scale, distance, and spatial relation carry the photographic purpose.

guidance.en: let scale, a physical reference, and the measurement contact point explain the frame
guidance.ko: 스케일, 물리적 기준물, 측정 접점이 프레임의 이유를 설명하게 한다

refinements.principle: For measurement and inspection frames, let scale, reference evidence, and the contact point explain why the photograph exists.

guidance.en: connect habitat, a repeatable observation boundary, and scale evidence in the same field record
guidance.ko: 서식 환경, 반복 가능한 관찰 경계, 스케일 증거를 한 현장 기록 안에서 연결한다

refinements.principle: For field observations, let habitat, a repeatable boundary and scale evidence explain both what was observed and how.

dimensions.baseline_principle: Light should appear to come from a believable source, with direction, falloff, bounce, and exposure behavior affecting both subject and setting.

guidance.en: give the light a believable source with direction, falloff, and bounce
guidance.ko: 빛이 방향, 감쇠, 반사광을 가진 설득력 있는 출처에서 오게 한다

dimensions.label: light-source continuity

guidance.en: keep available light directional enough to reveal exposure and bounce
guidance.ko: 현장광의 방향, 노출, 반사광이 추적될 만큼 분명하게 남게 한다

refinements.principle: Available or low light should carry a traceable direction and exposure logic.

guidance.en: let artificial light leave consistent color, shadow, specular edges, or exposure evidence
guidance.ko: 인공광이 색, 그림자, 반짝이는 경계, 노출 흔적을 일관되게 남기게 한다

refinements.principle: Artificial light should leave consistent color, shadow, specular edge, or exposure evidence across the frame.

guidance.en: let atmosphere alter the light through diffusion, reflection, or softened contrast
guidance.ko: 대기가 확산, 반사, 부드러운 대비로 빛을 바꾸게 한다

refinements.principle: Atmosphere should change the light through diffusion, reflection, softened contrast, or suspended particles.

guidance.en: keep illumination, sensor response, reference surface, and noise consistent with the instrument
guidance.ko: 조명, 센서 반응, 기준 표면, 노이즈가 계측 장비와 일치하게 한다

refinements.principle: Instrument-led imagery should keep illumination, sensor response, reference surface, and noise behavior consistent with the selected modality.

dimensions.baseline_principle: Organize the viewer's reading order across foreground, subject plane, and background instead of letting every detail compete equally.

guidance.en: organize foreground, subject plane, and background into a clear reading order
guidance.ko: 전경, 피사체면, 배경이 분명한 읽는 순서로 정리되게 한다

dimensions.label: frame hierarchy

guidance.en: use foreground interruption, a clear subject plane, and background falloff
guidance.ko: 전경의 가림, 선명한 피사체면, 배경의 초점 이탈을 함께 사용한다

refinements.principle: Layered frames need a deliberate foreground interruption, subject plane, and background falloff.

guidance.en: make focus priority and frame-edge behavior unmistakable
guidance.ko: 초점 우선순위와 프레임 가장자리의 처리가 분명하게 보이게 한다

refinements.principle: Close frames should make focus priority and edge behavior unmistakable.

guidance.en: use negative space, scale, or symmetry as a reading path rather than empty scenery
guidance.ko: 여백, 스케일, 대칭이 빈 배경이 아니라 시선의 경로가 되게 한다

refinements.principle: Wide frames should use negative space, scale, or symmetry as a reading path rather than empty scenery.

guidance.en: organize origin, route, transfer point, and destination into a legible flow
guidance.ko: 출발점, 경로, 이송 지점, 도착점이 읽히는 흐름으로 구성한다

refinements.principle: Operational scenes should reveal origin, route, transfer point, and destination through a clear spatial reading order.

guidance.en: organize input, physical decision evidence, and the next destination into one traceable reading order
guidance.ko: 입력물, 물리적 판단 근거, 다음 목적지가 한 번에 추적되는 순서로 구성한다

refinements.principle: Traceability frames should order the incoming batch or object, decision point, and continuing destination without relying on readable labels.

dimensions.baseline_principle: Give the frame a captured instant: a transition, hesitation, aftermath, or micro-event that could only exist at this moment.

guidance.en: give the frame a captured instant rather than a finished pose
guidance.ko: 완성된 포즈보다 포착된 찰나가 프레임에 남게 한다

dimensions.label: decisive moment

guidance.en: catch a transition before it settles into a perfect endpoint
guidance.ko: 동작이 완벽한 끝점으로 굳기 전의 전환을 포착한다

refinements.principle: Living subjects should feel caught in a transition rather than frozen at a perfect endpoint.

guidance.en: make the camera feel timed to just before, during, or just after a small event
guidance.ko: 카메라가 작은 사건의 직전, 도중, 직후에 맞춰진 것처럼 보이게 한다

refinements.principle: Observer-like camera positions should imply timing: the photographer arrived just before, during, or just after something small happened.

guidance.en: show time through after-touch, slight displacement, use mark, or a settling detail
guidance.ko: 손길 뒤의 흔적, 살짝 어긋난 배치, 사용감, 가라앉는 디테일로 시간을 보이게 한다

refinements.principle: Still subjects can still carry time through an after-touch, slight displacement, use mark, or settling detail.

guidance.en: catch the handoff between workflow phases rather than a generic operational pose
guidance.ko: 일반적인 작업 포즈보다 공정 단계가 바뀌는 순간을 포착한다

refinements.principle: Process photographs should catch the visible handoff between workflow phases rather than a generic machine or worker pose.

dimensions.baseline_principle: Let the setting affect the subject or let the subject disturb the setting, so place is a photographic cause rather than a decorative backdrop.

guidance.en: let the setting affect the subject or the subject disturb the setting
guidance.ko: 장소가 피사체에 영향을 주거나 피사체가 장소를 흐트러뜨리게 한다

dimensions.label: environment consequence

guidance.en: make weather or atmosphere visibly change surfaces, edges, contrast, or movement
guidance.ko: 날씨나 대기가 표면, 경계, 대비, 움직임을 눈에 보이게 바꾸게 한다

refinements.principle: Weather or atmosphere should visibly change surfaces, edges, contrast, or movement.

guidance.en: show contact with place through pressure, occlusion, reflection, dust, or surface change
guidance.ko: 압력, 가림, 반사, 먼지, 표면 변화로 장소와의 접촉을 보인다

refinements.principle: Contact with place should create pressure, occlusion, reflection, dust, surface change, or spatial interruption.

guidance.en: let shared space affect spacing, paths, interruptions, or posture
guidance.ko: 공유된 공간이 거리감, 동선, 가림, 자세에 영향을 주게 한다

refinements.principle: Shared spaces should affect spacing, paths, interruptions, or posture instead of acting as neutral scenery.

guidance.en: show a weather-driven material consequence together with a monitoring or adaptation response
guidance.ko: 날씨가 만든 물성 변화와 모니터링 또는 적응 대응을 한 프레임에 보인다

refinements.principle: Climate conditions should produce a visible material consequence and one monitoring or adaptation response in the same frame.

guidance.en: show the condition evidence, intervention point, and changed material destination in the same frame
guidance.ko: 상태 증거, 개입 지점, 달라진 재료의 목적지를 같은 프레임에 보인다

refinements.principle: Repair and recovery scenes should show how diagnosis, contamination removal or separation changes the material's next state.

principles: Let one small bodily or behavioral trace interrupt pure polish: loose hair, breath, fabric creasing, sweat, handling, or an unguarded expression.

human_trace: loose hair, creased fabric, breath, or an unguarded expression keeps the subject photographic

principles: Make animal presence physical through fur, weight, pressure, contact shadows, shared light, or small behavioral timing.

material_trace: fur, whiskers, or small handling traces catch the same light as the surrounding scene
physical_contact: the animal's weight or posture creates pressure, contact shadow, and shared light on nearby surfaces

principles: Let objects show weight, surface finish, handling marks, cast shadows, reflection, condensation, crumbs, scratches, or use traces instead of floating as labels.

material_trace: surface finish, handling marks, condensation, crumbs, scratches, or dust reveal the material
physical_contact: object placement creates believable weight, contact shadows, and surface pressure

principles: Use window light, practical lamps, room color bounce, dust, and foreground domestic objects to make the subject belong to the room.

environment_binding: room light and color bounce touch the subject, nearby surfaces, and small foreground objects

principles: Use scale, vertical architecture, colored window light, candle warmth, dust, foreground occlusion, and floor reflection to bind a small figure to a large interior.

environment_binding: colored window light, candle warmth, dust, or floor reflection touch both the subject and the monumental interior
optical_depth: foreground candles, columns, arches, or floor reflections create deep environmental perspective

principles: Make performance light physical through color spill, haze, sweat, microphone metal, hair movement, and one captured choreographic instant.

environment_binding: stage color spill, haze, and reflected highlights touch hair, skin, costume, and equipment
event_timing: motion blur, breath, sweat, or a caught gesture makes the frame feel like a live instant

principles: Treat constructed worlds as photographed sets: fibers, seams, scale cues, color bounce, and foreground blur should affect the subject or object.

environment_binding: set color bounce and nearby handmade materials affect the subject and central prop
material_trace: visible fibers, seams, edges, or handmade irregularities reveal the photographed set

principles: Let moisture change surfaces through darkened fabric, wet hair, floor reflection, beads, haze, or softened light.

environment_binding: wet surfaces and reflections share the scene's light and color
material_trace: moisture darkens fabric, gathers on hair or surfaces, and catches the same light as the environment

principles: Make a relationship visible through gaze direction, hand position, spacing, and one shared task or object rather than by merely placing multiple people in frame.

event_timing: capture the exchange during a handoff, adjustment, briefing, or shared task
physical_contact: hands, spacing, and one shared object make the coordination physically legible

principles: Show the process at a specific stage and include the visible reference, contact point, or condition trace that explains what is being done.

event_timing: the frame catches one specific stage before the task advances to the next
operational_evidence: a calibration target, sample contact, inspection marker, or condition trace makes the operation verifiable

principles: Let the selected capture modality determine scale, depth, noise, field of view, and reference evidence instead of adding a generic technical overlay.

operational_evidence: a physical reference surface or calibration target grounds the instrument view without relying on readable UI
optical_depth: scale, field of view, focus falloff, and sensor noise follow the selected capture modality

principles: Make routes, staging zones, queues, and transfer points readable so vehicles, cargo, workers, and infrastructure form one operational flow.

environment_binding: route markings, staging space, shared light, and contact shadows bind vehicles or cargo to the facility
event_timing: capture one transfer, queue release, loading cycle, or maintenance pause
operational_evidence: a visible flow path or handoff point explains how the system moves

principles: Show climate conditions through changed visibility, bent vegetation, water lines, heat shimmer, deposited particles, or damaged surfaces, together with one visible monitoring or adaptation intervention.

environment_binding: the same weather condition changes foreground, subject, and distance rather than sitting as a background effect
material_trace: water lines, deposited dust, wind-bent material, frost, or heat shimmer leave a physical trace
operational_evidence: a monitoring reference or adaptation structure makes the environmental response legible

principles: Keep habitat, the repeatable observation boundary, scale reference and detected organism in one legible ecological relationship.

environment_binding: habitat structure, substrate and water or vegetation conditions remain connected to the observed organism
operational_evidence: the camera field, quadrat edge or physical marker makes the observation protocol visible
traceability_evidence: a repeatable frame, sampling boundary or reference position makes later comparison possible

principles: Show the material state before, during and after one grading or monitoring decision so the batch remains photographically traceable.

material_trace: natural bloom, surface activity, handling marks or condition variation reveal the batch state
operational_evidence: a sample contact, visible grading criterion or physical handoff explains the current process decision
traceability_evidence: incoming batch, decision point and separated or continuing output remain spatially connected

principles: Make the repair or separation decision visible through condition evidence, a physical test or contamination point, and a legible next destination.

material_trace: wear, solder condition, residue, contamination or fraction texture records the material's current state
operational_evidence: a probe contact, rejected contaminant or separation mechanism makes the intervention verifiable
traceability_evidence: the tested component or input stream remains connected to its repair, reject or recovered destination

principles: Keep viewpoint, landmark, focus, exposure, and a physical reference stable across the selected channel, time, depth, or view structure.

operational_evidence: a physical reference slide or fixed landmark grounds the acquisition without readable overlays
optical_depth: focus, section depth, and field of view follow one registered acquisition geometry
traceability_evidence: the same ROI and reference relationship persist across the selected acquisition structure

principles: Connect physical condition, a repeatable reference, and the intervention or derived-record stage without inventing readable accession data.

material_trace: surface wear, lifting, corrosion, or support pressure remains physically legible
operational_evidence: stable support, raking light, scale reference, or camera orbit explains the documentation method
traceability_evidence: the collection object, capture event, and treatment stage remain continuous without readable labels

principles: Show the adult participant leading a functional task while support products, helpers, and accessible space remain practical, dignified, and non-graphic.

environment_binding: eye level, working distance, and usable circulation keep the participant and support environment equally legible
operational_evidence: fit, use, follow-up, or clear-route evidence explains the current access task
physical_contact: hands meet the support product or route feature at a clear functional contact point

principles: Make one movement phase, its contact state, and any equipment or surface response legible without replacing mechanics with generic sweat or blur.

event_timing: the frame isolates one readable readiness, loading, release, impact, deceleration, or recovery phase
material_trace: compression, rebound, surface shear, droplets, or particles respond to the same force event
physical_contact: the body, ground, opponent, or equipment meet at one physically plausible contact state

principles: Show one observable learning stage through mentor-learner attention, tool contact, procedure, and result evidence rather than through classroom symbolism alone.

event_timing: the frame catches demonstration, supervised practice, joint diagnosis, or assessment at one specific step
operational_evidence: tool, procedure, practice result, and non-readable assessment reference form one complete activity frame
physical_contact: hands, gaze, and the workpiece meet at the same task contact point

principles: Prioritize time-sensitive physical evidence, a safe observation boundary, and the next condition decision without turning affected people into spectacle.

material_trace: water, wind, debris, deformation, or access traces remain specific to the observed hazard
operational_evidence: a control line, reference marker, or triage contact point explains the safety decision
traceability_evidence: the observed condition remains connected to its restricted, repaired, or re-opened state

principles: Use a state boundary, coexisting stages, layer thickness, partial burial, fixed reference, or directional arrangement that a single photograph can actually support.

environment_binding: the trace remains tied to its substrate, habitat, moisture, and scale reference
event_timing: coexisting stages or a persistent boundary imply process without claiming an unseen time-lapse
material_trace: layers, gradients, cracks, residue, or partial burial preserve the physical process trace

principles: Keep one stable spatial anchor and one changed physical or operational trace visible from a repeatable viewpoint, without inventing a split-screen comparison.

environment_binding: the same doorway, edge, fixture, or horizon anchors the place state
operational_evidence: setup, shutdown, maintenance, closure protection, or recommissioning leaves one observable state cue
traceability_evidence: viewpoint, scope, and reference relationship remain suitable for later comparison

principles: Use one dominant visual order and one physically verifiable cue; reflection, occlusion, scale, and transition must remain consistent with medium, depth, and contact.

environment_binding: one clear boundary, rhythm, or localized break controls salience while staying physically tied to the surrounding surface or space
material_trace: residue, compression, displacement, or a continuous state boundary points to a real prior or active process
optical_depth: occluding edges, reflective curvature, shared shadows, and same-plane scale anchors preserve spatial logic

principles: Colored or mixed light should spill consistently across subject, wardrobe, props, and nearby surfaces instead of sitting only in the background.

environment_binding: colored light spill touches the subject, wardrobe, props, and nearby surfaces in the same direction

principles: Close camera positions need visible focus falloff, foreground occlusion, lens perspective, or grain so the image does not flatten into a composite.

optical_depth: foreground occlusion, focus falloff, lens perspective, or grain reveals a real camera position

anti_patterns: centered beauty headshot pasted over a scenic background
separate studio face light that ignores the location's light direction
props listed as labels without contact shadow, reflection, weight, or physical interaction
a visible effect shell or flat image-plane slice that ignores local material identity, depth, and occlusion
principles: Bind the subject and setting with shared light, reflected color, contact shadow, moisture, haze, or material behavior.
Use a photographic point of view with foreground depth, asymmetry, focus falloff, grain, or lens artifacts instead of a clean pasted-on portrait.
Keep one small human, animal, object, or material imperfection so the image reads as a captured moment rather than a beauty composite.

environment_binding: ambient light spills across the subject, nearby surfaces, and props
reflected color catches on the main subject and the surrounding materials
human_trace: a small unguarded expression, loose hair, creased fabric, handling mark, or material imperfection breaks the polished pose
optical_depth: off-axis composition with foreground occlusion and gentle focus falloff
subtle lens grain and imperfect depth cues from a real camera position

material, contact, rhythm, or scale evidence

metacritical labels such as visual argument or unresolved tension used instead of visible action, placement, light, or material evidence

principles: Let one clear visual argument organize the image, but keep it grounded in the requested scene instead of turning it into generic melodrama.
Use tension, threshold, or public/private pressure as composition logic rather than caption-like explanation.
Keep the proposition observational: use placement, material contrast, timing, or use trace without forcing drama.
Make one small visual relationship legible through contact, light, arrangement, or surface behavior.
Give the frame one quiet reason to exist beyond beauty: a private routine, contradiction, threshold, or unresolved relationship.
Show the proposition through behavior, object placement, light, or framing rather than abstract mood words.

families.embedding_text: observable habits, relational stakes, and bounded state contrast build an original adult character without reducing characterization to costume
adult character affect made legible through action, expression, gaze, and contextual evidence
adult relationships expressed through shared targets, complementary action, distance, and repair
adult character continuity traced through physical state change rather than costume replacement
adult character bonds shown through maintenance, handoff, reciprocity, and small completed tasks
original nonhuman forms and companions whose identity and agency remain visible through action
adult original performers and transforming characters linked across states by action and continuity anchors
explicitly adult original characters expressed through observable action, relationship, and gaze

policies.definition: Route human subjects are explicitly adult; no appearance-based age inference.
Default every human character scene to an explicitly adult subject.
Treat convention familiarity as task context, never personal or cultural identity.
Do not infer gender identity from presentation, body, clothing, role, or affect.
Keep the decisive action readable without specialist symbol knowledge.
Require a plain behavioral and contextual reading before optional convention cues.
Keep market labels separate from visible attributes and styling.
Use market terms only as routing context, never as visual atoms.
Avoid age-ambiguous human design; declare adult status explicitly.
Do not rank cultures or audiences by familiarity or taste.
Do not infer ethnicity, nationality, or appearance from a market term.
Exclude gore, cruelty, abuse, unsafe restraint, and victimization.
Use original characters and generic adults; copy no named character or person.
Use original non-proprietary symbols and copy no named intellectual property.
Do not translate a market label into national costume or visual stereotype.
Preserve distinct CJK term scopes instead of declaring lexical equivalence.
Do not reproduce a protected character design, real-person likeness, or signature identity cue.
Do not reduce living sacred beings or practices to generic creature decoration.
Exclude sexualization and youth-coded body, styling, or framing.
Present adult bodies and gender expression without fetishizing emphasis.
Ground characterization in visible action and context without diagnosing an inner personality.
Select exactly one primary mechanism and no more than two support cues.
Do not infer sexual orientation from presentation, relationship blocking, or affect.

action.description: A declared actor or object performing one concrete activity at the selected instant.
action.description_ko: 소유자가 특정 시점에 수행하는 동작: 시선·연속 절차·정지 자세가 섞임; 과정 단계와 순간 동작 구별
excludes: 시선·연속 절차·정지 자세가 섞임; 과정 단계와 순간 동작 구별
includes: A declared actor or object performing one concrete activity at the selected instant.

adult_presentation_context.description: Explicitly selected adult presentation context; adulthood alone is not sexual styling.
adult_presentation_context.description_ko: 명시적으로 선택된 성인 표현 맥락: 성인 연령 조건과 분리; 성인 등장 자체는 성적 표현 근거가 아님
excludes: 성인 연령 조건과 분리; 성인 등장 자체는 성적 표현 근거가 아님
includes: Explicitly selected adult presentation context; adulthood alone is not sexual styling.

aesthetic_trend.description: Visual aesthetic movement or stylistic practice, distinct from an entire plot, institution or world system.
aesthetic_trend.description_ko: 미적·시각적 표현 경향과 관습: 수사 절차·범죄 시스템·설화 전승은 genre·world·narrative_core와 재분류
excludes: 수사 절차·범죄 시스템·설화 전승은 genre·world·narrative_core와 재분류
A named day phase or lighting treatment alone does not establish a visual aesthetic movement or stylistic practice.
includes: Visual aesthetic movement or stylistic practice, distinct from an entire plot, institution or world system.

aftermath_trace.description: Owned physical residue of an explicitly declared prior event, distinct from an arbitrary surface state or ongoing process.
aftermath_trace.description_ko: 명시된 사건 뒤 남은 물리 흔적: 진행 중 서리·색 탈색·준비 상태가 섞임; 사건 결과인지 일반 표면 상태인지 구별
excludes: 진행 중 서리·색 탈색·준비 상태가 섞임; 사건 결과인지 일반 표면 상태인지 구별
includes: Owned physical residue of an explicitly declared prior event, distinct from an arbitrary surface state or ongoing process.

age_presentation.description: Explicitly declared age range or visible age presentation of an identified carrier or its explicitly owned local region; local appearance does not establish whole-owner chronological age, and intrinsic adult restrictions remain unchanged.
age_presentation.description_ko: 대상 또는 실제로 소유된 국소 영역의 명시된 연령 범위·보이는 연령 표현. 국소적인 나이 들어 보임·젊어 보임을 주체 전체의 실제 연령으로 확대하지 않으며, 기존 성인 제한은 그대로 누적한다.
excludes: Generic matte/glossy/rough texture, synthetic-skin material, wrinkles or a skin-region name alone without explicitly declared age presentation.
Chronological age, birth/manufacture history, adulthood, species, identity, health or family inferred from local skin or a provenance label.
Aged finish on non-skin material, weathering or damage alone is not subject/region visible age presentation merely because the adjective old/aged appears.

Part ownership is not equivalence: local region age appearance cannot be moved to the whole owner or another region. Distinct actual regions can legitimately have contrasting values on the same whole owner.

Selected age appearance remains E; explicit existing declared-age prerequisites retain P and cannot be used as permission to mutate locked age. Adult/human/domain source guards are neither inferred nor removed.
includes: Keep explicitly declared whole-carrier age range and visible age presentation, without inferring real chronological age from appearance.

An explicitly aged-looking versus young-looking owned skin-region contrast is local visible age presentation. Retain each actual region and owner; no new person, baby, exact age, family relation or global aged/young assignment follows.
A represented or synthetic carrier only receives the visible age presentation actually stated for its own region; representation identity alone is not a living age fact.

When one selection explicitly expresses both local skin microtexture and age appearance, appearance and age are two permission projections of that same semantic selection. Author both footprints consistently under the current proof contract; this is not an instruction for engine inference, automatic duplication or removal of locks.

air_humidity.description: Explicit moisture content or humidity state of an identified body or zone of air, indoors or outdoors, independent of visibility, suspended droplets, surface wetness, temperature and weather.
air_humidity.description_ko: 실내외 실제 공기 또는 공기 구역에 직접 선언된 습도·공기 수분 상태. 가시성·안개 입자·젖은 표면·온도·날씨를 별도로 구별한다.
excludes: Humid mood, tactile suggestion or a humidity variable name without an actual declared state/value/change.
Fog, steam, haze, visible airborne droplets or attenuation alone does not establish an air-humidity state; humidity alone does not require visible fog, droplets or lowered visibility.

Wet/damp/dry surfaces, sweat, condensation or a moisture-bearing material alone does not establish surrounding air humidity; explicit air humidity alone does not authorize surface wetness or condensation.
Temperature, weather, immersion, cultivation or a room label alone does not establish humidity. Do not infer a weather cause, humidifier, water source, chemical identity, thermal state or process.
Do not replace the actual air/zone carrier with every room surface, the whole world or an arbitrary foreground/main owner.
includes: Explicit humid, dry or otherwise stated air-humidity state on the actual selected air/zone carrier, including a growing room or an outdoor air zone.
Preserve a stated humidity number, unit, relative/absolute qualifier and zone literally when supplied; do not invent a value, measurement, calibration, equilibrium or conversion.

Choose selected effect, independently required prerequisite or preservation from the whole source; room/air nouns do not determine mode. Keep actual source/binding guards and independently qualified owner/receiver locks.

ambient_particle.description: Individually distinguishable airborne particles or droplets and their spatial distribution, separate from an unresolved haze or fog optical field.
ambient_particle.description_ko: 공기 중에서 개별 형상·점·궤적으로 구별되는 입자·물방울과 그 분포. 물리적으로 미립자를 포함하더라도 개별 입자 없이 연속 감쇠장으로만 표현된 안개·연무는 atmospheric_medium이며, 수중 입자·영상 입자·표면 방울과 구별한다.
excludes: An unresolved haze or fog field described only through spatial attenuation or contrast loss.
Underwater particles or bubbles, image-plane grain and droplets attached to a surface.
A living airborne animal needs its own declared subject/participant evidence; the particle slot does not add one.
includes: Individually distinguishable airborne particles or droplets and their spatial distribution, separate from an unresolved haze or fog optical field.

anatomical_connection.description: Ownership and continuity, articulation, attachment or explicitly intended separation of anatomical parts of a declared biological subject, including a plant or declared botanical part. Explicitly depicted anatomy remains owned by its representation; non-anatomical artifact joins remain separate.
anatomical_connection.description_ko: 선언된 생물 주체의 해부학적 부위 소유·연속·관절·부착 또는 명시적으로 의도된 분리이며, 식물 또는 명시된 식물 부위의 꽃·잎·자기 줄기 연결도 포함한다. 명시된 해부학적 묘사는 그 표현물의 소유 범위에 머문다. 형태·비율·단순 접촉·비해부학적 공예물 접합과 구별하며 생존·성장·종을 추정하지 않는다.
evidence_terms: bloom attached to its own stem
excludes: Anatomical contour, regional volume, relative proportion or part names alone without an actual ownership, continuity, articulation, attachment or intended-separation proposition.
Touching, nearness, overlap or visual alignment of separately owned subjects/objects alone; contact does not merge anatomy or establish a shared biological owner.

Object hinges, hardware branches, textile/lace/paper flower assemblies and floral graphic-path joins alone. Depicted anatomical connection requires an explicitly declared anatomical depiction and remains scoped there, never inferred live continuity.

Continuity/attachment does not prove that an owner is alive, growing, functional, healthy, a particular species or made by a particular process; a cut or depicted botanical part does not gain a hidden whole plant.

An artifact or picture cannot alter/add a living actor or plant merely because its design resembles a biological part. Actor/plant/representation owner labels, source effects and optional members/profiles are not independent anatomical evidence.
includes: Ownership and continuity, articulation or explicitly intended separation of declared human or other animal anatomical parts, retaining each actual owner and endpoint.

The declared botanical bloom remaining attached to its own woody stem; separate blossoms attaching along the same continuous branch; leaves belonging to that same declared plant/branch. Source-stated absence or separation is retained without inventing extra organs.

Explicit anatomical attachment/continuity within a declared representation remains on the represented anatomy. A flat ornament path or assembled craft junction alone does not establish an anatomical relation.

Where a fabric rosette and a separate existing biological flower coexist, their distinct owners remain distinct: the flower own petal/stem relation cannot be donated to the garment, and cloth attachment cannot be recast as plant growth.

apparatus_pov.description: View through an identified aperture, optical apparatus or observation surface.
apparatus_pov.description_ko: 물리 구멍·광학 장치·관찰 매체를 통한 시야: 열영상·스캐너는 취득 방식도 관련; 카메라 종류·프레임 모양과 독립 근거 필요
excludes: 열영상·스캐너는 취득 방식도 관련; 카메라 종류·프레임 모양과 독립 근거 필요
includes: View through an identified aperture, optical apparatus or observation surface.

atmospheric_medium.description: Continuous or unresolved air, haze or fog and its spatial optical response, separate from individually distinguishable airborne particles, camera-path artifacts and emotional atmosphere.
atmospheric_medium.description_ko: 공기·안개·연무가 연속 또는 비분해 광학장으로 만드는 공간 감쇠·대비·가시성 상태. 안개의 물리적 미립자 유무를 사진으로 판정하지 않으며, 개별 공기 입자·물방울 형상은 ambient_particle, 촬영 광학 경로의 베일은 lens_artifact, 정서는 mood로 구별한다.
excludes: Individually distinguishable airborne particle or droplet units alone.
Camera-path veiling flare, image-plane grain or encoding damage.
Emotional mood, an inferred weather cause, or unobserved chemical composition.
An explicitly humid or dry air state without a stated spatial optical response belongs to air_humidity. Air humidity alone establishes neither fog, attenuation, visible droplets nor wet surfaces.
includes: Continuous or unresolved air, haze or fog and its spatial optical response, separate from individually distinguishable airborne particles, camera-path artifacts and emotional atmosphere.

attire_context.description: Declared role, culture, era or ceremony informing attire, separate from general garment construction.
attire_context.description_ko: 역할·문화·시대·의례를 명시한 복식 맥락: 일반 의복 구성과 분리; 전통 복식을 코스프레와 동일시하지 않음
excludes: 일반 의복 구성과 분리; 전통 복식을 코스프레와 동일시하지 않음
includes: Declared role, culture, era or ceremony informing attire, separate from general garment construction.

background_element.description: Declared secondary entities and structures in the background, separate from primary subjects and whole-place state.
background_element.description_ko: 배경 요소: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Declared secondary entities and structures in the background, separate from primary subjects and whole-place state.

body_form.description: Owned non-facial anatomical contour, regional volume or visible muscle and tendon form of a declared biological subject, including a plant or declared botanical part. Explicitly depicted anatomy remains owned by its representation. Independent of connection topology, relative proportions, pose, garment fit and non-anatomical artifact construction.
body_form.description_ko: 선언된 생물 주체의 얼굴 이외 해부학적 윤곽·국소 부피·근육·힘줄 형태이며, 식물 또는 명시된 식물 부위의 기관 형태도 포함한다. 명시된 해부학적 묘사는 그 표현물의 소유 범위에 머문다. 연결 구조·상대 비율·자세·의복 부피·비해부학적 물건 구조와 구별하며 생존 상태·종·건강·능력·정체성을 추정하지 않는다.
excludes: Body/plant region names, biological class words or connection topology alone without an independently stated anatomical contour or regional form.
Relative proportions, pose, facial geometry, garment fit or non-anatomical object/garment construction alone.

Floral graphic paths, repeating vegetal ornament, branch-shaped hardware or fabric/paper/lace flower parts do not become biological anatomy from resemblance or petal/stem labels. An explicitly declared anatomical depiction may describe represented organs only; its physical carrier remains an artifact.
A represented or artificial anatomical form does not alter or add a living actor/plant, and does not establish that its carrier is alive or that any depicted species exists physically.
Body weight, health, strength, biological age, origin, species, growth capacity, material chemistry or fabrication inferred from form.
Source owner, positive form and actual application scope must be explicit; metadata, source effects, an optional member/profile or an actor/plant/representation role word alone is not a form fact.
includes: Restrained visible muscle planes on a declared human or other animal; a localized neck vein contour or gluteal-thigh surface fold.

Large distinct floral segments forming an open cup on the declared botanical bloom; broad bounded leaf form or layered flower-organ form on its own declared plant owner. Plant form is not a claim of physiological life, growth capacity or species identification.

Explicitly depicted biological anatomy, including represented botanical organ form, stays on its declared representation. The source must actually describe anatomical form, not merely a floral style, motif or generic craft part.

A biological flower and a fabric rosette may occur in the same record, but anatomical form is assessed only on the declared biological flower or explicit anatomical depiction; cloth-fold form remains on the garment/craft owner.

body_hair.description: Owned regional body-hair density, length, distribution, skin attachment, individual-fiber thickness and pigmentation, separate from skin finish, scalp hair, facial hair and eyebrow or lash styling.
body_hair.description_ko: 지정 피부 부위에 소유된 체모의 밀도·길이·분포·피부 부착·개별 털 굵기·색소. 피부 마감·두발·수염·눈썹 및 속눈썹 연출과 구별하며, 선택한 속성만 적용한다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
Scalp-hair arrangement/color, facial-hair styling, brow/lash styling, skin pigment or skin optical finish alone.
Thickness or pigmentation does not prove age, sex, hormones, health, numerical composition or history.
includes: Owned regional body-hair density, length, distribution, skin attachment, individual-fiber thickness and pigmentation, separate from skin finish, scalp hair, facial hair and eyebrow or lash styling.

body_marking.description: Bounded natural, declared or applied markings on the owned body surface of an explicitly declared human or nonhuman actor, including a selected creature or machine-body design; owner and surface boundaries remain explicit.
body_marking.description_ko: 명시된 인간 또는 비인간 주체의 몸 표면에 한정된 국소 표식과 색 경계. 선택된 생물·기계 몸 디자인도 포함하되 기존 소유자·매체를 유지하고 인간 참조를 비인간으로 변환하지 않는다.
excludes: 화장·자연 표식·흉터 원인은 맥락 필요; 의복 무늬와 소유자 구별
A separate garment, bracelet, projected/cast shadow, emitted light or standalone object pattern cannot substitute for a body-surface mark.
A marking alone does not establish biological species, origin, injury/disease history or actual light emission.
Catalog permission never changes a candidate nonhuman-only guard or authorizes conversion of a referenced human.
includes: Bounded natural, declared or applied markings on the owned body surface of an explicitly declared human or nonhuman actor, including a selected creature or machine-body design; owner and surface boundaries remain explicit.

body_orientation.description: Explicit orientation of an identified body or relative rotation of its declared connected regions, including biological, mechanical and represented bodies.
body_orientation.description_ko: 생물·기계·묘사된 몸과 명시적으로 연결된 부위의 축 방향·상대 회전. 카메라 방향·전신 지지 자세·눈의 시선과 구별한다.
excludes: Camera position, body support pose, eye-gaze direction and a scene object facing the frame are not interchangeable.
Standing or an activity alone does not supply a rotation, connected region, angle, axis or reference basis.
Do not infer eyes, a nose, joints or a human torso from the role name or a mechanical subject.
includes: A declared body axis orientation or relative rotation of connected regions, with the actual regions, relation and reference basis stated.
A nonhuman or represented body can qualify on the same literal contract. Actual source conditions and available owner regions still apply.

body_pose.description: Explicit whole-body posture, support or articulation of an identified biological, mechanical or represented body, without inferring unmentioned anatomy.
body_pose.description_ko: 생물·기계·묘사된 몸의 명시적 전신 자세·지지·관절 배치. 실제 대상과 몸의 범위를 확인하며 언급하지 않은 신체 부위나 지지 접촉을 추론하지 않는다.
excludes: A rigid object shape, a camera viewpoint or an activity word alone does not establish a whole-body pose.
Relative rotation of body axes, hand articulation, concrete action and rendered motion have separate roles when supported.
Do not turn an unavailable body or limb into a new entity to satisfy a pose.
includes: Explicit standing, sitting, lying or other whole-body posture of a declared human, animal, robot or represented body.
Preserve the actual support and articulated connections when declared. Standing alone does not supply feet, legs, a supporting ground contact or a human body.
Decide effect versus a required existing posture from the whole source; source-specific category and domain conditions remain cumulative.

body_region.description: Named anatomical region or selected body part, distinct from the obligation to prove its visibility.
body_region.description_ko: 선택된 신체 부위와 관찰 범위: 부위 자체와 이를 보여야 하는 검증 의무를 분리; framing·해부 연결과 연계
excludes: 부위 자체와 이를 보여야 하는 검증 의무를 분리; framing·해부 연결과 연계
includes: Named anatomical region or selected body part, distinct from the obligation to prove its visibility.

brow_style.description: Owned eyebrow-hair shape, strand arrangement, grooming or cosmetic line, separate from expression-related elevation, lowering or convergence of the brow relative to facial landmarks.
brow_style.description_ko: 눈썹 털의 형태·결·정리 또는 화장 선. 얼굴 기준점에 대한 눈썹의 상승·하강·미간 수축 같은 표정 위치와 구별한다.
excludes: 자연 털과 화장 선은 적용 맥락으로 구별; 눈썹을 눈 화장 전체로 확대하지 않음
Expression-related brow elevation, lowering or convergence alone belongs to expression; it does not establish grooming, a cosmetic line or a private emotion.
includes: Owned eyebrow-hair shape, strand arrangement, grooming or cosmetic line, separate from expression-related elevation, lowering or convergence of the brow relative to facial landmarks.

calendar_context.description: Explicit day type or calendar interval such as weekday, weekend or eve, distinct from clock time and named occasion.
calendar_context.description_ko: 달력 시점: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Explicit day type or calendar interval such as weekday, weekend or eve, distinct from clock time and named occasion.

camera_direction.description: Camera viewing axis and roll relative to the subject, distinct from height, distance and body orientation.
camera_direction.description_ko: 카메라 관측 방향과 대상 대비 각도: 높이·관찰 위치·몸 방향이 섞임; 관측축과 위치를 별도 표현

includes: Physical camera-to-subject distance or declared observer separation, independent of shot scale and lens choice.

camera_height.description: Camera height relative to a declared reference, distinct from viewing axis and distance.
camera_height.description_ko: 지정 기준면·대상 대비 카메라 높이: 카메라 기울기·관찰자 사회적 역할과 구별; 높이만으로 광학을 확정하지 않음

camera_movement.description: Declared camera movement or support stability during capture, separate from subject movement and its recorded blur.

includes: Declared camera movement or support stability during capture, separate from subject movement and its recorded blur.

camera_type.description: Declared acquisition device class, distinct from its mounting and from the image's imitation of a device look.
camera_type.description_ko: 선택된 촬영 장치와 영상 취득 계열: 카메라 외관·장착 방식·매체 표현을 분리; 장치가 픽셀에 보이는지 별도 판정

capture_configuration.description: Arrangement of camera, operator, support, subject and reflecting surfaces during capture.
capture_configuration.description_ko: 운용자·지지·장치·반사면의 촬영 구성: 셀피 세부만으로 한정하지 않음; core의 camera.capture_mode 필드와 슬롯 ID를 구별

capture_context.description: Purpose, access, observational circumstances and recording context of photography, not apparatus geometry.
capture_context.description_ko: 촬영 목적·기록 상황·접근과 관찰 조건: 장치 배치와 물리 촬영 구성은 capture_configuration; 기록 경위는 픽셀 사실이 아님

character_contrast.description: Contrast between a declared character's visible bearing, local response, role or status.
character_contrast.description_ko: 한 인물의 태도·반응·역할 사이 대비: 권위와 주도권·계급 대비도 포함됨; 감정 모순으로만 정의하면 현재 후보 의미를 축소

cheek_makeup.description: Placement and distribution of cosmetic pigment on the declared cheek area.
cheek_makeup.description_ko: 볼 화장 색의 분포와 경계: 열·감정에 따른 피부 붉음은 skin_condition; 실제 화장층 근거 필요

color.description: Owned local colors and bounded color arrangements, separate from whole-image grading.

color_grading.description: Image-wide or specified tonal-band color and tone transformations, preserving locked local colors.

companion_animal.description: A separately declared animal participant explicitly accompanying an identified primary subject, with the companion relation, count and ownership grounded.
companion_animal.description_ko: 명시된 주 대상에 실제로 동반하는 별도 동물 참여자. 주 대상과 동물의 동반 관계·수·소유자를 각각 확인하며 주 대상을 인간으로 한정하지 않는다.
excludes: A lone animal, an animal name, another animal in the background or a generic peaceful mood alone does not establish companionship.
Do not infer pet ownership, species, domestication, affection, physical contact or a new primary subject from the tag.
An animal-only source with no accompanying relation must use its actual subject/action roles instead.
includes: An explicit animal companion relation to the declared primary subject; the primary subject can be human or nonhuman.
Keep animal identity/count, independent owners and any required contact or placement conditions exactly as supported.

complexion_coverage.description: Opacity and region coverage of the owned complexion cosmetic layer.
complexion_coverage.description_ko: 피부 화장층의 덮는 영역과 불투명도: 피부 자체 상태·색·반짝임과 구별; 화장 소유 범위 명시

composition.description: Arrangement of declared elements and negative space within one frame.

concept_tension.description: A declared conceptual contrast embodied by identifiable owners or states, not an unsupported abstract label.

contact_point.description: Explicit contact, support or occlusion relation with each endpoint and owner identified.
contact_point.description_ko: 연결된 소유자·신체 부위·물건의 접촉 관계: 행동명과 구별; 지지·가림·압력 표현은 실제 연결과 상태 근거 필요

crowd_density.description: Spatial occupancy and density of a declared group within the frame, with actor counts preserved.
crowd_density.description_ko: 관찰 범위 안의 집단 밀도와 공간 점유: 관계 이름·행사 종류·인원 잠금과 구별; 모든 분야에 동일한 허용 범위 강요하지 않음

declared_person_background.description: Explicitly declared personal origin or background used as context, never inferred from appearance.
declared_person_background.description_ko: 명시된 인물 배경 맥락: 국가 출신은 외모로 확인할 수 없음; 얼굴 특징·국적을 서로 추론하지 않음
excludes: 국가 출신은 외모로 확인할 수 없음; 얼굴 특징·국적을 서로 추론하지 않음
includes: Explicitly declared personal origin or background used as context, never inferred from appearance.

depth_of_field.description: Depth extent of acceptable sharpness and background or foreground blur, separate from focus-plane selection.
depth_of_field.description_ko: 심도: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.

includes: Depth extent of acceptable sharpness and background or foreground blur, separate from focus-plane selection.

environment_detail.description: Local wear, utilities and use traces owned by environmental surfaces or fixtures.
environment_detail.description_ko: 환경의 국소 세부: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Local wear, utilities and use traces owned by environmental surfaces or fixtures.

exposure.description: Recorded exposure, clipping and preservation of tonal information, separate from incident light level.
exposure.description_ko: 기록 노출과 톤 범위: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
excludes: 대상·속성·관계를 실제로 표현할 때만 직접 역할로 판정하며, 맥락·원인·정체를 외관에서 확정하지 않는다.
includes: Recorded exposure, clipping and preservation of tonal information, separate from incident light level.

expression.description: Observable facial or eye-area response belonging to one declared human or animal, or visibly presented by an explicitly declared artificial face or face representation. Includes expression-related brow position relative to facial landmarks; not a proven private emotion, consciousness or hidden muscle action. Artificial and represented responses remain on their declared carriers.
expression.description_ko: 선언된 사람·동물의 관찰 가능한 얼굴·눈 주위 반응, 또는 명시된 인공 얼굴·얼굴 표현물에 실제로 드러난 표정 반응. 얼굴 기준점에 대한 표정성 눈썹 위치를 포함한다. 인공·묘사된 반응은 선언된 물체·표현물의 소유 범위에 머물며, 사적인 감정·의식·숨은 근육 작동이나 시선 방향·목표·눈맞춤을 추정하지 않는다.
excludes: 시선 목표와 사적인 마음 상태를 표정 사실로 취급하지 않음
Eye or iris direction, a named gaze target or camera/participant engagement alone; these properties require their own evidence and roles.
Consciousness, absence of mind, actual emotion, personality, intention, successful perception or hidden muscle operation inferred from an expression, including empty-looking machine gaze.
Face shape or proportions, sensor/optical-iris hardware, material, skin finish, grooming or cosmetic line alone without a positively declared facial response.

An artificial or represented facial response does not imply living skin, biological eyes or eyelids, newly added facial parts, a living carrier or an additional human/animal. Preserve the actual artificial or representation owner; do not convert it to biological anatomy.

Metadata, old slot names/effects, an optional member/profile, or an actor/object/representation owner label alone cannot supply a face, facial response or unconditional application scope. Intrinsic source conditions and independently frozen binding conditions remain conjunctive and unchanged.
includes: Observable facial or eye-area response of one declared human or animal, including expression-related brow position relative to facial landmarks, without proving private emotion.

An explicitly declared artificial face presenting an empty-looking machine gaze or a too-precisely held social expression. The source must positively describe the visible facial response; robot identity or sensor hardware alone is insufficient.

A visible expression explicitly described on one declared face representation remains owned by that representation and its carrier. It neither creates a living actor nor transfers a depicted response to another subject. A generic facial resemblance or ornament label alone is insufficient.

eye_detail.description: Owned local eye structure, iris color and surface appearance, distinct from gaze and surrounding cosmetics.
eye_detail.description_ko: 눈의 색·구조·관찰 가능한 국소 속성: 대체 안구 연결·충혈·눈물은 추가 역할; 일반 외모와 시선 관계를 구별

includes: Owned local eye structure, iris color and surface appearance, distinct from gaze and surrounding cosmetics.

eye_makeup_line.description: Path and boundary of cosmetic eyeliner around the declared eye.
eye_makeup_line.description_ko: 눈 주위 화장 선의 경로와 형태: 아이섀도 면·자연 눈 경계와 분리; 선의 실제 위치를 명시
excludes: 아이섀도 면·자연 눈 경계와 분리; 선의 실제 위치를 명시
includes: Path and boundary of cosmetic eyeliner around the declared eye.

eyeshadow_style.description: Cosmetic pigment or shimmer distribution on selected eyelid regions.
eyeshadow_style.description_ko: 눈꺼풀 화장 색·영역·층의 배치: 아이라인 경로·속눈썹 구조와 분리; 자연 안구 색과 구별
excludes: 아이라인 경로·속눈썹 구조와 분리; 자연 안구 색과 구별

facial_geometry.description: Owned facial shape, local anatomical geometry and proportions, separate from cosmetic contour or skin finish.
facial_geometry.description_ko: 얼굴 윤곽·부위 형태·비례: 모든 후보가 둘의 관계는 아님; 피부 마감·화장 명암과 실제 형상 구별

excludes: 피부 질감·머리 모양과 구별; 면도 상태도 같은 외관 축
includes: Facial hair form, length and distribution, including a visibly shaved state.

fetish_styling.description: An explicitly selected fetish styling context with appropriate adult scope, not a material-only inference.
fetish_styling.description_ko: 명시적으로 선택된 페티시 표현의 활용 맥락: 가죽·라텍스·반짝임만으로 판정하지 않음; 현재 한 후보의 물리 요소는 일반 의복과 겹침
excludes: 가죽·라텍스·반짝임만으로 판정하지 않음; 현재 한 후보의 물리 요소는 일반 의복과 겹침
includes: An explicitly selected fetish styling context with appropriate adult scope, not a material-only inference.

film_emulation.description: A coherent visual emulation of a named film or photographic medium, without claiming the medium was actually used.
film_emulation.description_ko: 선택한 필름 계열의 복합 영상 표현: 입자 하나는 grain_profile; 실제 필름 사용 여부와 모사 외관을 구별

focus.description: Placement and priority of the focus plane and relative sharpness of named planes.
